description: Canonical installed-hardware qualification cases. Every accepted firmware revision must pass all applicable mandatory cases against verified installed bytes.

cases.description: Exercise the installed browser assets and reset bridge, Agon reset/readmission, live ExCom keyboard and renderer text capture, display status, P4/EMOS SD round trip, and final startup restoration.
Prove mode 8 to mode 20 to mode 8 commits with no browser client and with one retained browser-video connection, then restore ordinary startup.

Prove RST 08h raw SD write effects on MBR-proven pre-partition sector 2, observe a per-run completion token after all raw I/O ends, then restore and verify the exact preimage through the independent C dispatch.
